name: llmvault
description: Local, vault-aware question answering for Obsidian

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/ollama.test.mjs test/indexing.test.mjs test/conversations.test.mjs test/plugin-data.test.mjs test/security.test.mjs test/quality.test.mjs test/acceptance.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke && node evaluation/proof.mjs --record-tests
scripts.quality:run: npm run build && npm run quality:manifest && node --experimental-strip-types evaluation/run.mjs
